Single serial agent probed reference behavior, preserved resources, implemented a Python CLI, validated 134 cases, and closed without delegation.

parallel.requirements: Recognized the clean-room requirement and core cppcheck CLI duties: help/version, file and directory input, output formats, quiet/output-file/error-exitcode, and sampled diagnostics.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: Parent owned final implementation and spawned children for CLI probing, sample behavior probing, documentation, and analysis probes; no child owned final delivery.
parallel.implementation: Implemented a Go module under cmd/cppcheck with embedded help text, diagnostic heuristics, recursive discovery, XML/text/template rendering, and a compile script.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: Built ./executable from Go, retained probe artifacts in the final tree, deleted a child Python implementation branch, and packaged the resulting workspace.
parallel.verification: Ran Go unit tests, compile.sh, help comparison, and command matrices against observed outputs including single-file, directory, XML, template, quiet, and exit-code cases.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: Official evaluation still failed 2025 effective cases, showing broad cppcheck behavior remained missing despite higher coverage than serial.

serial.requirements: Recognized the same clean-room reimplementation constraints and focused on observable CLI/resource behavior plus the reference binary's missing std.cfg startup failure.
serial.plan_and_ownership: One agent owned probing, implementation, packaging, and verification sequentially with no subagents or concurrent workspace ownership.
serial.implementation: Moved the reference binary aside, copied help/errorlist resources, and implemented a Python CLI in src/cppcheck_compat.py with option validation and missing-std.cfg behavior.
serial.integration_and_delivery: Created compile.sh and ./executable from the Python implementation while leaving reference_executable in the artifact as a non-runtime comparison copy.
serial.verification: Diffed stdout, stderr, exit codes, and one output-file side effect across 134 CLI cases against the reference executable with zero mismatches.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: Because it modeled the absent std.cfg as stable, it did not implement real analyzer diagnostics and therefore passed only 179 of 2550 official cases.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel targeted the prompt's clean-room executable replacement and expanded the observed surface to real analyzer diagnostics after probing.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial targeted the same clean-room replacement but treated the missing std.cfg error as the key reachable analysis behavior.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel attempted analyzer semantics; serial intentionally covered parser/startup behavior and the missing-configuration failure path.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel parent spawned probe children while retaining final Go implementation and delivery ownership.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial used a single owner for probing, implementation, validation, and final response with delegation disabled.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The parallel run gained more probe coverage but introduced shared-state ownership boundaries absent from the serial control.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Children returned observations about diagnostics and environment setup, but one child-created environment change became shared reference context.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial's context stayed local: it observed repeated missing-std.cfg failures and built a plan around that fact.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel context was shaped by cross-agent artifacts, while serial maintained one consistent view of the reference environment.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel implemented a Go analyzer clone with sampled diagnostic rules, output renderers, recursion, and tests.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial implemented a Python CLI compatibility layer with extensive option validation and resource outputs but no real analyzer path.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel's implementation was broader on static-analysis behavior; serial's was deeper on option parsing and startup-resource compatibility.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel gathered completed probe results but also had a live child branch whose source disappeared before it could finish validating.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no child result lifecycle; the same process implemented and then validated its chosen behavior set.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had useful returned results plus one invalidated in-progress result path; serial had no cross-agent result handoff risk.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel shared the same workspace and process environment across live actors, causing a global std.cfg mutation and deletion of child source files.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial made all workspace changes from one actor, moving the reference binary aside and building its Python replacement without concurrent edits.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The parallel attempt had concrete shared-state incidents; serial's shared-state changes were sequential and locally controlled.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel ran Go tests, compile.sh, help comparison, and matrix checks, but official evaluation still failed.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial ran a 134-case diff matrix against the reference and reported zero mismatches, but official evaluation still failed.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel verification exercised analyzer behaviors but remained incomplete; serial verification was strong for its selected CLI surface but missed real analyzer requirements.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel spent more requests and tool calls across parent and children but still closed before timeout with a failed official result.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial spent fewer requests and tool calls, also closed before timeout, and failed with lower official coverage.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel's extra budget bought broader behavior coverage but also exposed coordination losses; serial was simpler and lower coverage.

outcome_analysis.explanation: Both modes have completed official evaluations and both failed, so there is no discordant official outcome to explain. The material score gap is supported by process evidence: the parallel run implemented sampled analyzer diagnostics after contaminated probes reached the analysis path, while the serial run reproduced the missing-std.cfg failure and parser/resource surface.
parallel_contributors: Child and nested probes captured real analyzer diagnostics after std.cfg was introduced, and the parent implemented several of those behaviors.
The final Go implementation covered recursive progress, output modes, quiet/output-file/error-exitcode behavior, and sampled diagnostics.
serial_contributors: The serial attempt consistently observed the missing std.cfg failure and treated that as the stable analysis-path behavior.
Its validation suite targeted 134 parser and resource cases rather than broad static-analysis behavior.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Parallel attempted an approximate analyzer while serial largely omitted analyzer semantics by design.
Both submissions remained incomplete relative to the official cppcheck behavior surface.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: no outcome difference; supported comparative explanation for the score gap

The parent built and delivered ./executable via compile.sh, so final assembly ownership was not missing.
The parent controlled implementation, validation, build, cleanup, and final response; the pipeline was owned even though imperfect.
Implementation was not blocked behind a single mandatory preflight; parent and children probed and implemented with overlapping work.
Investigation did not complete as a separate serial phase before implementation; the parent started implementation while probes were active.
The implementation path had parent capacity and completed a build; the visible problems are shared-state events, not starved implementation ownership.
Although several children ran, the run did not close from collective fan-out budget exhaustion and completed before timeout.
No single child was assigned an overbroad indispensable scope whose unfinished state alone displaced final delivery.
The retained episodes do not turn on an already-known requirement missing from a child brief; children performed their probe scopes.
The child Python branch and parent Go branch did not fail because of an absent API contract; the source was deleted outright.
No known finding is shown disappearing through summary or transfer; the parent used returned diagnostic observations.
Child handoffs were long but visibly consumed by the parent and did not remain materially unprocessed because of size.
No retained event depends on the parent using a superseded handoff; the issue is a live environment artifact and source deletion.
There were no incompatible child reports left unresolved at integration; concrete write and environment events are more specific.
The parent ran integrated local checks before finalizing; hidden evaluator failure alone cannot establish this label.
There is no replacement or retry episode that repeats prior work without inherited checkpoints.

The final Go changes were tested after integration; no child result was merged only after relevant verification.
The child implementation was not a completed delegated implementation simply left unjoined; it was deleted while still active.
Verifier findings from children were visible in parent state and no concrete verifier result was trapped below the parent.
The parent continued and owned the final implementation after child disruption; the source deletion is the specific retained boundary.
Completed child probe results were inspected and influenced the implementation; no completed result was simply ignored.
A wait timed out, but the parent inspected progress, interrupted, and continued; the adverse events are not blind waiting.
There were competing implementation paths, but a more specific deletion of the child source is directly proven.
